one_line: Lock the phone off in a real room, show the product from frame one, add big captions.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a baby of about one sits laughing in a round beige ball pit, a cream sofa behind; static wide shot. Voiceover (transcript): 'תכירו את בריכת הכדורים של בליס'. Subtitles: 'תכירו את בריכת הכדורים', 'היא בגוון אבן מושלם'.
q1_hook.why: The product is on screen with a laughing child from frame zero, and the line is said and subtitled together (S1, H3, H6). It names a product, not a need: 'meet the ball pit' gives no problem or promise until the look line at 0:04 (H2, H1).

beats.what: Locked wide shot, baby laughs and claps; 'בגוון אבן מושלם'; the camera moves in at 0:05
beats.why: Product, joy and the look claim in one take.

beats.what: Top-down, baby lying among white balls on a bed, laughing; 'היא עשויה מבד'
beats.why: A new angle and a laugh.

beats.what: Close-up of the baby's bare feet against the fabric; 'מבד קורדרוי רך'
beats.why: Shows the soft fabric the voice names.

beats.what: A nursery with a crib and a tent, baby holds a ball; '200 כדורים', 'תקן הישראלי לבטיחות'
beats.why: Count and safety, said over a smiling baby.

beats.what: The pit by a window with sheer curtains; 'פשוט'
beats.why: A third room: it fits any corner.

beats.what: On a patio, baby sits then pulls up on the rim; 'זה מסוג הדברים שאני יכולה לתת לו'
beats.why: A new setting and a small action.

beats.what: Top-down, baby leans over the rim; 'לגעת ולחקור', 'בקיצור'
Close-up of the baby among the balls smiling; 'גם פריט שאני באמת אוהבת לראות בבית'
beats.why: Ends on the smile and the verdict.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. The caption is one line and asks nothing.
q2_flow.why: Different rooms and angles add something new every 2 to 6 s, each tied to a spoken fact, with the baby's laughter as the pull (R3, K1). But the first shot holds 8 s and the facts are a brand-style list with no problem (R1, R3). The last close-up smile gives the Reel its peak (R4).

q3_cta.what: None. The last line, 'גם פריט שאני באמת אוהבת לראות בבית' (0:23, subtitle to 0:27), is a verdict. Caption: 'הפינה החדשה והאהובה של' with the child's name, then 'בריכת הכדורים של @bliss.il 🫧'. No link, price, code or question.
q3_cta.why: A clean verdict ending (E8), but no next step on screen or in the caption: no price, link or where to buy (C6). Nothing invites a comment or a send (C4, R6). A mood piece, not a conversion.

q4_shown.what: The beige ball pit with a baby in it from 0:00; a top-down shot among white balls 0:08; the soft fabric wall against the feet 0:10; three settings 0:12 to 0:22; a top-down shot of the baby at the rim 0:22. No price.
q4_shown.why: The product is in use and the baby's laughter is the proof (S1, K8). Three rooms show it blends in, answering the 'colourful toy' worry the voice names (K5). 'Israeli safety standard' is said, with no label shown (K4). The baby's face is shown (S5).

q5_edit.what: 8 shots in 28 s (3.5 s each): a locked wide shot for 8 s with a slow push-in at 0:05, then static shots of 1.5 to 5 s. Straight cuts, no speed changes. Bold white subtitles in 1 to 3 word chunks.
q5_edit.why: Static frames and a straight cut per sentence keep it calm and clear (E2). The 8 s first shot is long for a hook (E1, R1). Subtitles follow every sentence (T2). It stops on the last line (E8).

q6_topic.what: A stone-coloured ball pit that blends into the living room, shown in three rooms with a laughing baby. Serves a parent who wants baby play gear that matches the home.
q6_topic.why: A real home worry, 'toys that do not suit my living room', answered with a calm look and a safety note (K6). The baby's laughing is a warm peak (K1). It has no story or surprise, so it is mostly a showcase (K2).

q7_filmed.what: Phone on a tripod or locked off: wide and medium eye-level shots, two top-down shots, one close-up of feet. Soft window light in a sofa room, a nursery and a patio. A baby of about one, no adult on camera.
q7_filmed.why: A steady, locked frame in clean light keeps the product sharp and calm (F7, E6). Top-down shots put the viewer over the baby (F5), and close-ups fill the frame (F4). The tidy rooms read as styled more than homemade (H8).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold sans-serif subtitles with a dark outline, 1 to 3 words per cut, centred at about 80 to 88% of the frame height, in sync with the voice: 'תכירו את בריכת הכדורים' (0:01), 'היא בגוון אבן מושלם' (0:03), 'נקייה ואסתטית' (0:04), 'עשויה מבד קורדרוי רך' (0:10), 'מגיעה עם 200 כדורים בגוונים' (0:12), 'לבטיחות' (0:15), 'בקיצור' (0:23), 'לראות בבית' (0:27). No headline card, no CTA.
q8_text.caption: 'הפינה החדשה והאהובה של' and the child's name, then 'בריכת הכדורים של @bliss.il 🫧'. One line, about 10 words. No hashtags, question, CTA or disclosure word.
q8_text.why: Large keyword subtitles are easy to read and work muted (T1, T2, T5), but they sit in the bottom 35% (T4, F2). The caption names the product but no occasion or search words, with no hashtags (T7). The child's name appears in the caption beside the baby's face (S5). No partnership word (T8, S7).

weak_points: An 8 s first shot with no problem; subtitles in the bottom band; the child's name in the caption beside the face; no price, link or CTA; no partnership word.
lumebook_takeaway: Lock the phone off and show the book in a real room from frame one, with 1 to 3 word captions. Hands only, no child.
not_verified: Whether the voice is the creator's own; the safety standard claim (not checked); music (none evident); whether the Reel is paid (label 0). Correction: no adult is on camera, so face_on_camera is 'no face' and the push-in happens at about 0:05, inside the first shot.
